notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content: [h3]Greetings everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]Today I give you all the latest update, featuring a brand new map, including a few extra quality of life improvements. I was somewhat hesitant on releasing this update, since I was wanting to add a brand new safe-house/ base building module for the game. However, this may take quite a while to not only implement properly, but to make sure all of the planned features work as intended. So I though why not just release what we have now, and put in full effort for the exciting plans that I have brewing up.[/p][p] [/p][p]Before I get into the patch notes, I would like to personally thank Czikago. Not only has he impressed me by achieving a high score, but has also bought a lot of fixes, and many potential suggestions to my attention, some of which that are in this update that I provide today.[/p][p]I have experienced a lot of lows when developing this game. There have been many times where I wonder if it’s worth putting all of this money and time into this project. Having in depth chats with players like Czikago, who provide valuable feedback on my game gives me that push of motivation to keep on going, so thank you.[/p][p] [/p][p]First off, let’s move onto the big additions added.[/p][p] [/p][h2]New Map: The Ruins of Truth.[/h2][p]This map is taken straight out of my first novel, The Chronicles: Wasteland; where the renowned town of Truth has been destroyed by The Creator, and its machine army. Many weeks later, as the smoke continues to rise from the fallen structures, you find yourself in the marketplace, where Screamers and other monsters alike now call this place home, where they find and finish off stranded survivors. Your goal, like the other scenarios you have experienced before, is to escape![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/dd088c954c12619bb2782e033d1dd921deef2374.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll notice that this map is smaller than the other two. However, it gives you more wriggle room to navigate and to understand the objective of this new landscape you find yourself in. The objective is straightforward: Buy batteries, place them in the power modules, turn on the power, and repeat the process to escape through the main gates.[/p][p] [/p][h2]New Screamer skins.[/h2][p]The Ruins of Truth, and the previous map, Red Hill Peninsula, will now feature a new variant of Screamers (that are more lore-accurate to my novels) along with a new variant of the butcher; one where the wasteland has gotten the better of a normal man, and has now turned them feral.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/085ac50c40e27e1a729a7d1fc9b308deb935b798.png"][/img][/p][p]The Screamers and butchers from the asylum level will retain their original look as you have all come to know. The new enemies will still retain the same animations, and usual gameplay, but will add more variety to the world itself.[/p][p] [/p][h2]New medal: Handy Man.[/h2][p]This new 4 tier medal will not only make your more proactive in repairing barriers, but will also further boost your final score. It will also assist you in reaching the requirements for the necessary achievements too.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/adec1912ea19239a0d416d9c4e118ae8e044ddf7.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2]New enemy counter.[/h2][p]You’ll notice on the right side of the screen that a new icon and counter has appeared. This will assist you in knowing how many enemies that remain in the current round so you’re no longer wondering what lingers and remains in the distance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/71b466c56429649f00652376cd2ba2966b13a469.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Round countdown timer.[/h2][p]We always try to make sure that every map is bug free, and thoroughly test every section. There are rare occurrences where players will encounter glitches where Screamers will lose their way, and their navigation bugs out. Below the enemy counter, you’ll notice a clock that counts down from 5 minute intervals with every new round. Once the timer reaches 0, all remaining enemies will die, and move the player onto the next round. This will remedy those rare occurrences where the last Screamer cannot be found, soft-locking the player, and forcing them to quit their game, forfeiting their score.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/41b6f64feb8282020c939ab29032f0a5b6560f27.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Other additions:[/h3][list][*][p]Finding the game too easy? Well, no worries. On round 10, Screamer running speeds increase by 15% with a new running animation. Still too easy? Well on round 20, they’ll have another 15% buff in their speed. I hope you have the level 3 sprint perk by then.[/p][/*][*][p]Added brand new music in new ROT map[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds when buying weapons and ammo to “confirm” purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]4 new achievements have been to complete RHP and ROT in both standard mode, and nightmare mode.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Fixes and changes:[/h3][list][*][p]RHP has had its sky and distant terrain changed to fit the wasteland theme.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the health of both Machine Screamers and the butcher to make them less bullet sponges.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of both the shotgun and sniper, making them feel like proper power weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of enemy navigation with all maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objective errors in RHP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where text didn’t appear when buying perks and other scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skin errors with weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a golden machine Screamer at round 10, and replaced it with a regular one in RHP since it didn’t belong in that map.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping has been restored to 100% height.[/p][/*][*][p]The SMG has been moved to the lower left leg when not in use.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the cost of the self revival perk to 5,000 points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some broken requirements for achievements.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]That’s about it for now.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has provided positive feedback and has shared their suggestions. There is much more coming in the pipeline and I’m excited to share more further down the line. Have a good weekend.[/p][p][/p][h1]-Mr. Ox.[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/15a2918ef9aa5c07f4a1e59e0d72dcd993bc3216.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: TC:WA Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello all, introducing a brand new update for the weekend. This update is a big one. I'm excited to go through the new features and changes that you can now play. Let's get right to it!

[h2][u][b]New features:[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]Red Hill Peninsula.[/h3]
[/list]
This new map is a breath of fresh air! You are now stranded at an old hill, untouched by the bombs from the Grey War, that was once owned by a secretive old man who has now vanished. This place may be a hidden paradise to some, but you'll soon find out that this isn’t the case.

Objective: Repair the old broken down car with three major components that will get you out of here in one piece. Only one component can be carried at a single given time, so be sure to fix it to the car before picking up another item.

[list]
[*] [h3]Nightmare mode.[/h3]
[/list]
This mode introduces a new, and fatal spin to how you play the game. Nightmare mode will surely be a challenge if you find the existing levels too easy. Both the Asylum level and the brand new Red Hill Peninsula will feature the Nightmare mode, including future levels that are in development.

Objective: Escape by all means in the pitch darkness. Your only friends is a flashlight, and you guns. Not only will items be more expensive, and have extra objectives to complete, but you will take more damage compared to the normal mode. Oh, and the generator will turn off every 5 minutes.

[list]
[*] [h3]BMG.[/h3]
[/list]
The Bandit machine gun is a new weapon that has been added in both maps. Hope you’re packing plenty of ammo, because this high recoil, bullet spitting death machine may just be everyone’s new favourite weapon. With a high magazine count, and a frightening rate of fire, this may just be the weapon to get you high in the leaderboards.

[list]
[*] [h3]Medals.[/h3]
[/list]
Boost your final score by killing as many screamers as possible, and by earning as much points as you keep drawing breath. Depending on your performance, medals will range from bronze, and all the way to diamond. In the end, when you either meet your inevitable fate, or survive, you final score will be altered, depending on how well you stive.


[h2][b][u]Minor changes[/u][/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] The menu has been touched up
[*] Added a new loading screen
[*] 5 new achievements
[*] Implemented a credit system and XP system. Nothing can be done with this now, but will be expanded upon later.
[*] Corrected a lot of character poses
[*] Once hitting round 15, Screamers will now run towards the player. Watch out!
[*] Firing without aiming is now easier to pull off. Before, the camera suddenly snaps.
[*] Adjusted health to the spectrum of enemies, depending on the round the player is on.
[*] A lot of other minor fixes have been applied.
[/list]

DLC 2 was meant to be out today, but we ran into some minor things that we have to fix. But I just couldn’t wait in releasing this build, so why not check out the store page and wishlist it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417420/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_2/]right here![/url]

Oh, and the first DLC is on sale. So if you wish to help me out, and show your support, grab this at a low price [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409530/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_1/]right here![/url]

notes.title: March Progress
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, hello.[/b][/h3]

Here is a little end of month update to show you the progress that has been made for the next big content drop. Expect everything here to be up and live within the next couple of weeks.
First off, let’s talk about the new map being worked on.


[h2][b]Red Hill Peninsula[/b][/h2]

This new, and challenging map will prove to be an uphill battle for survival, quite literally in fact. The screenshots shown may be somewhat familiar if you have played this before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/d40848e1fb1f3497c35ef37b78f338855778c1e2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/7229c3b1eb6d1c3f4beda04ff69b5f351ff619f8.jpg[/img]

That's right, this was the shack level that you find yourself in now when you want to load up a level. It has now been converted into a proper map, where the goal is to collect parts for your broken down car, and to find a way to break open the gate to escape.
Not only that, but there will be another version of this level, coming with this update, which brings me to my next exciting content announcement...


[h2][b]Nightmare mode![/b][/h2]

Are you a hardened gamer? Do you find the current levels too easy, and trivial? Well, try out nightmare mode, where surviving is going to be a... well, a nightmare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/fb419aa67d58357829e20a25bb442ca4476ffabb.jpg[/img]

With the screenshot provided, you're going to be stuck in the dark, with only your trusty flashlight to guide you through this challenge. Some of the differences included in this game mode includes:
[list]
[*] Total darkness, your flashlight is your only friend.
[*] More expensive doors to unlock, expensive guns to buy, and pricier ammo to go with it.
[*] The generator will turn off every 5 minutes. Forcing you to restart the engine if you want to buy new upgrades or perks.
[*] An extra objective to initiate the finale.
[/list]
Completing this mode will truly show that you have what it takes to be on the leader boards. As a matter of fact, the better you perform during your game will net you bonus points, which brings me to my next point...

Medals

Medals are minor milestones that you will passively achieve during your gameplay. These medals will reward you bonus points that will boost you up on the score board. There are different tiers of medals, each one earning you even more bonus points. They include...
[list]
[*] Total kills,
[*] Accumulated points,
[*] Turning on the power,
[*] And finishing the level.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/9b890c6875701e7bd2a43c417e6323b6c75e6966.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/f347c7c976cc03e035537f13800092b9e6f20df5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/156677cb6bcbb687ca0963b0365e55af62501a3f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/2b64fa6d3cb37ba76a9806d1aebdbbfa3de43705.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/e6eecbae06819745640bdee50d3f22fe00b492a1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/882cc7c259ee3a5e285509cb4eef9793090ff4db.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/dc55285b8b190442fcc968167ea1510598d45685.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/9f250856b97be224c47b0d5feb32e82db63ba728.png[/img][/url]

This new feature will encourage you to take that risk of trying to survive at least one more round before initiating the finale. Will you risk it all to earn that little bit extra?

[h2][b]New gun: BMG[/b][/h2]

It doesn’t matter who you are, or what kind of gun-nut you may be, the Bandit-machine-gun (BMG) will guarantee that it will deliver satisfying fire-power, now matter what the situation may be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/ddf91b04009d7fd7c4d57f528a57e62fe0504940.jpg[/img]

This erratic, high fire-power, bullet spraying manic will be a roadblock for anyone, or anything, trying to pursue you. Just keep in mind, that when you do get you hands on it, to not keep the trigger held down for too long. You may just end up firing into the roof.

[h2][b]XP and Credits system.[/b][/h2]

For a while, since first designing this game, I've always knew that looking for a reason to play a game at least once is an important aspect. What is more important however, is having a reason to launch the game a second time, and playing it again.
With this new update, you will acquire experience points with every attempt in survival mode. The better you perform, and the more medals you earn, will shoot you up the many new ranks that will be introduced to TC:WA.

Not only that, but we're introducing credits as well; a currency that you'll earn with every completion of a level, whether you either die, or succeed, you'll get a little something out of it.
With this update, you'll be able to buy a few things to make your profile look better, along with some weapon skins to boot. It may be minor for now, but this new system will benefit you greatly in further updates in the future.

Thank you for reading. I look forward in sharing this update with you all very soon. Thank you for the support and the kind words that I have read from some people.
Have a good weekend.

Mr. Ox.

Hello everyone! I am very pleased to finally share the newest 1.1.0 update. I'll cut right to the chase and list all of the newest editions to the game, with the fixes to follow.

But first, if you wish to support me, I’d like to celebrate the latest update by sharing two pieces of purchasable DLC for the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/459346559fa93f5c219fef4174952fc94e913924.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/19b8d5464fa8c7b71c4c488d91db2e5cdaea180a.jpg[/img][/url][b]TC:WA soundtrack.[/b]
This features all of the current music in the game, including some upcoming tracks that will be applied to the game later in future updates. You can get it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176350/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault_Soundtrack/]here[/url].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/755b59062d632574510e1919700936496c04529e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/0e68f3c84f6a1abaa50e5f8f41839c4ecc0dbcee.jpg[/img][/url][b]TC:WA supporter pack 1[/b]
Introducing the first skins DLC that can be applied to all weapons currently in the game, including the new battle rifle that is included in this latest update. It’ll also give you the ability to change your laser colour to green for the attachments that can be applied. You can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409530/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_1/]here[/url], with 40% already off the cheap price.

[h3]Major additions:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Map extension and finale: Find all three keys to escape the asylum and to explore outside the grounds. Have the ability to escape if you can start up the car, and survive the finale onslaught, adding more to your final score.
[*] Battle rifle: Try out the new semi-automatic precision weapon, located on the second floor of the asylum. Being a reliable medium ranged weapon, it may just become your favourite firearm.
[*] New Screamers: Zombies be gone! Introducing the true horrors of the wasteland: Screamers! A great representation of how these violent, unreasonable beings are seen in my novels.
[*] New gore system: Explosive headshots, blood puddles and spattering chunks will surely be therapeutic, and bring you back for more. (After dozens of hours play testing these builds, seeing this never gets old. I may need help)
[*] Selectable characters, and gun inspection: Three playable characters have been added to the game, each with their lore-friendly background and five selectable skins to change up their tone. You can also inspect each usable weapon, read how they work, and how each attachment changes the behaviour of your weapon. Did you purchase the supporter pack DLC? Here is where you’ll be able to apply the skins, and change the laser colour.
[*] Leaderboards: What the highest score you can reach? Show it off on the Steam leaderboards. (This may be altered sometime in the future to cater to different modes and fixes.)
[/list]

[h3]Minor additions and changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] You can now spend 1,500 points to on the second floor to unlock a quick escape back to the first floor. This is a great way to avoid using the tight and narrow stairs down. Be warned however, for you must use the stairs to climb back up.
[*] AR damage has been lowered by 25% while the shotgun has seen a 200% damage buff! (Whoa!)
[*] My fourth book has been added to the extras menu.
[*] You can now see your stowed weapons on your characters body.
[*] Fixed a bug where holding F to repair a barrier can be done no matter where you were in the map.
[*] The scope attachment for the sniper now zooms in much further than any other weapon.
[*] Added a new picture to the loading screen.
[*] Added 2 new achievements.
[*] A whole bunch of other minuscule bugs have been squished.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues that will be corrected:[/h3]

[list]
[*] When switching weapons, the camera sometimes snaps in a certain direction.
[*] Depending on the character you’re playing, the shoulders on the player model look very high while in the shack level.
[*] Only 1 golden machine Screamer is meant to spawn on round 10, but there appears to be 2 right now, earning you two gold keys when you kill them
[*] The laser for the supporter pack appears blue, when it’s meant to be green.
[/list]

What to expect next?
Besides more bug fixes, we are moving on to work on a new map, one that will be bigger and more open than the asylum. Along with that will be yet another new weapon, another playable character, and a few other additional pieces of content to explore in the game.
Thank you to all of those who have shown their support, either through kind words, a positive review, and to those who consider purchasing the new DLC. I look forward to sharing more with you all in the coming weeks.

Mr. Ox

notes.title: Janurary progress
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello everyone.[/b][/h2]
January has been a very productive month, and we are very close to releasing the next update. Here is a summary on what to expect in the next week or two for when the update finally launches.

[h1][b]Offical soundtrack DLC![/b][/h1]

Within a weeks time, you will be able to purchase the first piece of official content for TC:WA. The soundtrack will come with 15 tracks that are currently in the game, with some that have yet to make the cut. You can wishlist it now, and once it's out, for the first 7 days, you'll be able to purchase it for 40% off.
You can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176350/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault_Soundtrack/]HERE![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/cad0ad94d821ad7d0dc017eb56eb6810a6e44de4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Map extension.[/b][/h1]
As of writing this, the map extension for the asylum level is close to finishing. This is the very last piece of the puzzle that is needed before we finally launch the update. Here are some preview pictures of what it is going to look like. All that there is to do is lighting, terrain detail, some extra props, and coverage of far points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/16ce00178b92186d2f9a9c24007b86d93216c32e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/5e7bd22ccabdddbefefd63085d87a367d1194438.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/2438949fae5e1101ebd3fe1271c5b373717517e4.png[/img]

In order to get outside, you will need to find 3 keys within the asylum. 2 of them spawn randomly with every new playthrough. Depending on how observant you are, you should be able to escape the facility as early as round 10.

The bronze key will spawn in one of the three staircases that lead to nowhere. Be warned, searching for this key in the middle of a round will surely result in your death.
The silver key will spawn in one of the hanging body bags that scatter throughout the level. In order to take it, you must shoot the correct body bag to extract the key. If you have a sharp eye however, you will be able to tell what body holds the key.
The gold key can only be taken by force. During round 10, a special golden machine screamer will spawn and come after you. Kill it in order to take that key. After you have all 3, you will be able to leave the asylum, and will have the opportunity to escape!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/3f72e5f016e4079a681bbc418c55a3f08e46f108.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]New gun: The Battle Rifle.[/b][/h1]
The battle rifle meets you in the middle of being an accurate gun, but one that is also quick to tear through lines of Screamers. As usual, it has 5 attachments that can be applied that will make this weapon more of a deadly tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/6c18980761f4fb393d5000f97989475878db3782.png[/img]

[h1][b]New Screamer models:[/b][/h1]
Once the update is live, you’ll be greeted by a more accurate representation on the horror of what a Screamer looks like in my novels. They will replace the zombies that are currently in the game, along with some new sounds to go with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/f8dd67d2b1deb8d431cd9d049e469d877aa703ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/2e57a3a1367bcea27d75291bae386d899ef0eac8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/cc931f122b1657e3fc95c15c57e39c98bd4d3af8.png[/img]

Leaderboards:
After some testing and further adjustments, we have now got leaderboards working. Once the update is live, your scores will be publicly displayed on Steam, adding a somewhat competitive edge to the game itself. I can’t wait to see how far some people can get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/86d1d0c0ce9f7af9be943a764e7b3fe1b71cf720.jpg[/img]

There is so much more that is going to be added in this update, but I won’t put it all up on here. Once this is live within a week or two, there’s a lot more to discover. Until then, have a good long weekend, for my Australian players.

-Mr. Ox

notes.title: December progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

December has been a productive month so far, and we're going full steam ahead. Today I am going to show off some of the new features that are going to be in the next update, along with other assets that are a work in progress.

Below, I have inserted a video, allowing me to properly demonstrate the new and upcoming features that will be live in a few weeks time. I also clear a few things up about where the game is headed.

[previewyoutube=Ftmyc497fwg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h1][u][b]Character selection[/b][/u][/h1]

Moving forward, once this update becomes live, there will be a new tab to click on in the main menu. From there, you'll notice a selection of characters to choose from and to play as. They all have their own background, and lore friendly story that fits within the world of the game, and my books.
Keep in mind that the screen shots are only an example, and aren't final. There still needs to be some tweaking with the format, but you get a good idea of what it's meant to look like from this picture below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/6f70822790b2e085bb758ce61491ea8e6027dae5.jpg[/img]

Once the update is live, you will be able to select 1 of the 5 characters to play as, each with several basic skins to choose from. Depending on the reception and feedback given from some players, we'll slowly add more characters as the updates roll out.

[h1][u][b]Weapon skins[/b][/u][/h1]

There is also a new "weapon inspect" tab on the main menu. This will allow you to inspect the selected weapon, read the background of the firearm, and once the new DLC is live, you'll be able to apply a skin, and select the laser colour, once you have implemented the attachment during the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/6f61068855b297bab905357adc382725047e320a.jpg[/img]

This new "supporter pack" DLC will grant the user access the use of the "bloody mess" skin for all 5 available weapons that are currently present in the game. This DLC is more of a testing ground for me, to see how I can support this game. Having a small scale DLC like this is good practice for other future content. It will be available at half price for the first couple of days for players that wish to help me out. Showing me this kind of support will help me out greatly, and will keep the fires burning to further keep this game going.

[h1][u][b]New Screamer models[/b][/u][/h1]

Currently, the "Screamers" in the game now don't exactly look like how they're meant to be. My books clearly show a different creature, and let's face it, the enemies currently present in the game are pretty much just basic zombies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/e9a746f0240068d8a5be20a320743825ccb331af.jpg[/img]

This is a page from my first book. I'm sure you can tell that that creature isn't what you see in the game. That's why we have gone back a step and have modelled a brand new Screamer model that will be live in the upcoming update, where they will replace the current zombie models. Here is a little preview on what it looks like so far.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/a7c6b86b7b008c1c51e4581a0562c89f953e671d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/87f7f161de8c65989c39a34fcb11b23d8139ba53.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/57db5213c4a343142dc69467f9ef055ec1b48c28.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/725552ea6d4dab4776e96d46eab933c3698086b9.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/b9e87fb2fbcf72aa867acf40e90e45d321c43ca3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/6cb2c5ea0cd2b7e304ecdc507d9f93277fc5a6af.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c8a2505c06a302b5c8044c68263947ad06e2261b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/a52feb87544a3450e771625a906af7b4c6c54f73.png[/img][/url]

It looks fantastic! All there is left to do is optimising and unwrapping the model to paint it, and obviously clothe the Screamers to suit the theme of the level, speaking of which, the new level!

[h1][u][b]The Ruins of Truth and a new weapon[/b][/u][/h1]

Along with the update, there will also be a new level introduced, that will be bigger and have more of a complex role to play in order to get as far as possible. It will be called The Ruins of Truth. A destroyed town that takes place in my book, that was once a proud standing settlement, now a destroyed waste of life. You, the player are the only one remaining, and you will have to fight your way out of this ruined hellscape.
Along with the new map will feature a new weapon, the battle rifle; a accurate, semi-automatic weapon that acts as a marksmans best friend. While it is not as powerful as the sniper, you'll find it to be more forgiving if you end up missing a few shots here and there. It will be implemented in the new map and the existing asylum map.

Along with this major update, it will feature a bunch of other fixes that are still present in the current game. Hopefully, the leader-boards will also be up and running, showcasing players high scores, whilst further optimising it at the same time.

That's all for now. There's still a lot to do. Until then, thanks for reading and your support.

Mr. Ox

notes.title: TC:WA Update 1.02
notes.content:
[h1][b]TLDR:[/b][/h1] For this update, you'll notice the new safezone that you'll load into once you press play. This place will play a much larger roll in the future. For now however, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and use the table inside the cabin to launch the asylum level. Check below to see specific update notes.

A lot of progress has been made this week. You'll notice that once you hit the play button, you'll be taken to a new area that will serve as a player hub, where in the future, you'll be able to choose what level you will like to play, and even further down the line, there will be many more exciting things to do there.

[u][b]Major additions:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] New Safezone map
[*] Leaderboards (currently, it is only a template for now, but within the next few days, it will be functioning properly)
[*] New HUD elements. (Right hand side, showing new players how to evade and access their weapon wheel)
[/list]

[u][b]Minor additions / fixes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Volume slider for music
[*] Volume slider for general sound
[*] Shadows are set to high by default
[*] Players will now start off with 500 points on a new game (We're testing the waters to see if this makes the start too easy)
[*] Barriers now no longer break by themselves if there are no Screamers present
[*] Two invisible walls on the first floor have been removed (before, players couldn't hit spawning Screamers in the hallway barriers)
[*] The size of the picture preview in "buy the books" have been reduced by 25%
[*] SMG now fires 50% faster
[*] The sniper could penetrate multiple enemies without having the 5th attachment
[*] Removed some instances of Screamers getting stuck on the barriers
[*] You can now repair barriers by holding F instead of having to press it over and over again
[*] Resolved a bug where the butcher kills you with one hit, regardless of what rank of buffer you had
[*] Removed the backpack from the character
[*] Removed two cots upstairs, allowing to train a line of Screamers easier
[*] Achievements should be functioning properly. Before, they we're unlocked at inconsistent times, or not at all. Either way, we'll keep an eye out.
[/list]

[u][b]What to expect in the next few weeks:[/b][/u]

With the asylum level being our "testing grounds" I am happy with the way it is. The formula of how the gameplay works is at a point to where I'd like to stick with it, and further expand it on more levels to come. So, with that said, the next update will be a few weeks away, but it will be a [b]BIG [/b] one, possibly bigger than the game now, how it was at launch, so look forward to that.
I'm wanting to add an extra weapon to the game, a new, and bigger map, more playable characters, new Screamer models, and a few more additions to top it off.

Again, like always, you are welcome to leave your feedback here, our discussions page, and even look at our [url=https://trello.com/b/gVZgk8oA/tcwa-update-board]Trello[/url] to see the progress we're making.

Thanks for all of the support shown by everyone. I'm very eager to get a move on, and further expand this game into something bigger.

Mr. Ox

notes.title: What's been happening with TC:WA!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello all! It has been quite a while.[/h1]

So, what's been going on with this game? It's a tricky question to explain but let me start off with the progress that has been made so far.

[h2]First off: The redirection with this game.[/h2]

So after a while of updating this game when it first came out, it became clear to me that the current state wasn't really going anywhere. There was that little itch in the back of my mind that pressured me into moving the scope of what I wanted this game to be. So, after a long talk with TecShield, we did just that.
My first priority was character creation. Now, personally, I love when games allow me to craft my character to look however I want. This is exactly what I communicated to the team, and within a couple of months, it became a reality. So far, it is still a work in progress, however the core mechanics are in the game. You can pretty much create whoever you wish with our editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/97e51ea2817a1f6e3a373304d82e0434c44e1df3.jpg[/img]

You can even go the "Oblivion route" if you wish. Something I think is necessary for a game like this. It is the wasteland after all, why not make your character look like they've been through something freaky. Maybe make them go through a mutation or have them be created by a madman experimenting with individuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/41aced386d3401753d7c4d61f97edd8bf0118635.jpg[/img]

[i]"Oi! Come over er donkey!"[/i]

Or make them look full on Schwarzenegger

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/022db11e6f6e67094f847835de57663838547e6d.jpg[/img]


Alright, so you kinda know where we're going with this. You can make them look however you wish. Morph them into yourself or turn your character into something from a nightmare! I sure had fun messing around with this, but what you see isn't final, there is still so much to do for this module. There are more hairstyles to add, more clothing to suit your needs and even a roleplaying background selecter that will modify your unique creation into something more personal.

[h2]Second: The new path[/h2]

While we're focusing on keeping the game's vision as it currently is now, I made the choice to change up how the introduction works. What I mean by that is the safezone. Having those little lizard people guide you through was my first idea at the time, but everyone else's feedback was somewhat of the opposite. So, while everything else is more or less the same, I have instead allowed a different approach when it comes to the starting world.

Introducing: The new safe zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/5017ac00cd24fd108347f7444d7098bbc5690e6d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/29e4b339e4b5ece65e1aa44df74a1d8d1863e1a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/f0653e2385ed47d066fee840a2ecd766c2525a49.jpg[/img]

Right now, we have implemented a multi-storey building that will act as a new safezone for the player. This will allow the player to tend to their needs; as in sleeping to make night into day, modding and customizing their weapons, change their clothing, change the ambient music and even read a book! That's right, you can even sit down and read my whole book: The Chronicles, Wasteland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/a1c150a5958c499c0cd1f6f8132f26761764912d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/d5df2a19a412240221c1396c1e8249c0ae3be02f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/159d250ab6fca43051c643e82f997185d697717f.jpg[/img]

I wanted this to be included with the base game. If the player wishes to know more about the world that they're currently playing in, I thought it would be a nice addition to give supporting players my whole first book as a thank you.
After the player is ready to venture out into the wasteland, they can scavenge and loot in the city map. Just like how you can now, you can gather materials, collect credits, find ammo and so on. The idea of finding the previous underground safezone at a later time is possible. Maybe that can be a place for you to have a breather if things get overwhelming for you.

Now do keep in mind that all of the above isn't publicly out yet, there are some things in my personal life that I have to address before closing out this update.

[h2]What's happening with me?[/h2]

Now, you may know that I'm someone who's been funding this game by myself for a very long time. I work an insane amount of overtime at my job just to pay the TecShield developers and to support myself and the family. A new hurdle has appeared in front of me, it's called the Victoria Police.
My application has been going very well. I've been passing the required tests left and right and I'm nearing completion in becoming an officer. However, there is something that has hit me financially hard: my eyeballs!
To put it simply, my vision has failed me. I currently am short sighted, and I failed the minimum requirement for the sight assessment. I could either close my application and continue with my monotonous life, or get surgery. I'm sure you can tell where I went with this. So after thinking long and hard about it, I went with the latter. As of publishing this article, my surgery is set on the 21st of Nov, this coming Tuesday. While exciting as this may be, it has been very impactful on my wallet. It's pretty much come down to me putting progress of this game on hold until I have fully recovered and am confident on continuing this project. I mean, 6,000AUD for improving my life-long vision is very appealing and to secure a job in law enforcement, but it was painful to communicate with TecShield that the game has to be paused at the current moment.

That's kinda where we're at now. Progress on improving the game has definitely been made, but more time is needed to drop an update that will turn this game into something more worthwhile. It's a dream and a legacy that I don't wish to give up on, I love it too much.

[h2]Besides all that:[/h2]

I have lowered the price of the game to $5USD, it should reflect correctly for your currency, but this was something that should've been standard from the start. You'd think you'd get more results from a game that you've spent so much money on, but hey, not all investments are worth while. Either way, it's my legacy that I will leave behind, but it's one I don't plan on abandoning.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello all![/b]

It’s been a hot minute, but for good reason. There’s quite a lot of things to get through right now so I’m not going to waste any time and will go through the changes this new build has. Afterwards I’ll be highlighting what the team and I are going to be up to in the next coming weeks.

[h1]First off, the map overhaul.[/h1]

This map still uses the same landscape and locations as the previous world. If you’ve played this before, you should notice some… minor changes to the level.
As I’ve mentioned before, the map that the game launched with was a good starting point, however I wasn’t satisfied with the aesthetic of the world and it doesn’t reflect well in my books. If you were to play this game and read the novels, you would think that these are two completely different worlds. This build changes that by, well, making the map look like it’s gone though a whole century.
However, I am going to cut this section short, because this isn’t going to be the final version of the world. In the coming months, there are going to be some serious changes to the game itself. I’ll explain more further down but I’ll quickly cover a cut feature that I don’t think many people knew of.

[h1]Top down mode.[/h1]

This game has gone through several changes since we started this project around 2 years ago. The game was meant to be exclusively an isometric game, where the player survives wave after wave against Screamers, think of CoD: Zombies.
Over time however, new ideas came, and soon enough, third person was implemented and with ever update, top down mode because more and more obsolete to a point where the mode was broken and unusable. With the way the game plays now, third person is much more suited as a default mode anyway. So we removed the top down mode and replaced the TAB button to switch shoulders of the character so you’ll have an easier time to look around corners.


[b]But that’s pretty much it…[/b]

Besides a few minor fixes, this is how the game will be… for now
Recently I have had a thought, something that’ll pretty much change TC:WA for good in a positive light. These past few months after releasing the game has taught me so much in how to handle building a game, showing it off to thousands of people and releasing it for the public to play. Besides a few harsh comments, this has been a huge learning curve for me and now I’m ready to take it up to the next gear. Doing this will take a bit of time, but after observing how everything turned out, the wait will surely be worth it.
Let me walk you through what’s in the oven right now.

[b]Character creation.[/b]
I’ve grown up as someone who loves RPGs, you name it: The Elder Scrolls series, Mass Effect, Fallout and so many others. I’m actually doing a new playthrough of Mass Effect Legendary edition right now and the crucial component of such games always have one thing that I absolutely adore: character creation.

Nothing is better to me than seeing a reflection of myself in a virtual world where I’m the hero. I want this to be the case for TC:WA! What we’re doing right now is going to be quite literally a game changer. The team at TecShield are currently experimenting with a powerful new tool that will give the player endless freedom to how they want their character that is surviving the wasteland to look.
[url=https://www.instagram.com/zaighamgram/]Zaighamgram[/url] is doing a fantastic job making sure this implements into the game seamlessly. Not only will you be able to customize the way your character looks in the game, but you will also choose their background and their alignment to truly immerse you in this world. Right now, there is very little to show off right now. These next coming weeks will be focusing on adjusting everything to fit properly into the game itself. After this has been done however, there is going to be more!

[b]Base building and world overhaul![/b]
The underground bunker was a good start in terms of giving the player a place in not having to worry about the dangers of the outside world. To me however, it wasn’t MY safezone, that’s what kind of gave me doubts after releasing the game, Other players will experience the same place that didn’t really allow them to say “this is my safezone” if that makes sense. You were really a guest in someone else’s bunker and after a while, you didn’t really feel like it was a place that you belong.
This is what I’m striving to do now. Having a large landscape that the player can call their own and build their camp into a stronghold where they can be proud of what they’ve built.
As I mentioned before, the world will change as well. One that will be custom made instead of a pre-built map that exists currently. That’s what I meant by this won’t be the final version to the world with this build. After the previous two modules are completed, a new map will be forged that will properly be optimized and made to cater to a mysterious wasteland, full of secrets and horrors.

In saying all of this, the current build (V:1.2.0) will be as is for a while now. Not that anyone is playing this game anyways, I’m pretty much typing this out as if I’m talking to myself. But if you’re someone who already owns the game and is reading this far out of curiosity; thank you, there’s going to be a lot of exciting new features that are going to be put in over the coming months. Even if there’s going to be a slow-down on game builds, I’ll still be updating everyone on how things are going ever few weeks/fortnights.

That is all for now, thank you for your support and for reading on.

-Mr. Ox

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello all. Just in time for the summer sale with a brand-new fortnightly update. I will be honest; I must have completely misread Steam and the sale date because I swear I read that it was starting late July, like the 20th or something. Kinda shocked me when I saw that it was starting now. Nevertheless, this update is quite the chunky one with a few new additions. It originally took a week to implement but then we took an additional week to fix the bugs that were present. If you think this update is impressive, wait until you see what we have in store for the next couple of weeks.

Now just to let everyone know, the next update that’s coming on the 15th will reset everything. This obviously includes progress, but it’s for a good reason of course; there will be a new prologue introduction for new players to properly show them what this game is about. For Halo Reach players, think about the Lone wolf mission and how that ended. I think that’ll be a great way to introduce everyone to what this world holds.

It’s been over a month now since TC:WA came out and already I’ve learnt a lot about how to handle launches, feedback and updates. Thanks to everyone who’s been positive and have provided constructive comments about how we can make this game better. Other than that, here are the new patch notes:

[h2]New Screamers![/h2]

[*] Machine Screamers: To fight, or not to fight. Do not cross this foe when you’re low on ammunition. They hit pretty hard too.

What is also being worked on is new assets including buildings and clutter around the world. To put it simply: I’m sure almost everyone knows that a majority of this game world has shared assets that a lot of Unity developers use, mostly including apocalyptic type of games. These assets have been great to use as building blocks to make the game. However, I’m now wanting to diverge this existing map into a more personally crafted one that suits my world better.

If you take one look at the world, you would think that only 10 or 20 years have passed since the apocalypse began. In my novels however, it’s been over 100 years and the world would look so much more different compared to what’s in the game now.

Hello everyone! A new patch is out and things are looking pretty good. The new looting system is finished and the team has added over 430 new locations for you to find items to help you on your journey. [h2]What to expect next week:[/h2]

The AR that the player picks up in zone 2 has a bug where it dumps its mag within a second after pulling the trigger. We’ll fix that.

Adding new Screamer variants.

New missions!

That's it for this week. What we're working on next will add so much more life and thills to the game. I look forward to sharing this with everyone. Until then, have a good weekend.

notes.title: What's new 01/04/23
notes.content:
[b]See ya March, hello April![/b]

It’s been a quite a month of progress since our last update. We’ve just finished this milestone, full of fixes and modifying existing content. Currently, we are on our last milestone, and this will be the final touches to truly make this game a great first impression. For now, let me show you what we’ve done. But first, have you seen our new trailer? Ohhhh it's so new and shiny!

[previewyoutube=nS28z5mPD1M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h1][u][b]Equipment cards[/b][/u][/h1]

I’ve showed off equipment cards before, a lot of them have now been optimised that each have their own special effect and visual impact on the character. During your travels, you will come across and earn these cards where you can merge copies of the same card to buff the effects and decrease the cooldown timer to use them again. There are two types of cards, active and passive; both are pretty much self-explanatory. Active cards are used when you need them, pressing the hotkey will bring the card into effect and will have to cooldown until you can use them again. Passive cards are the opposite, I’m sure you can guess. You simply equip these cards and they’ll always have an active effect. As a matter of fact, let’s show a few of them off so you know what I’m talking about.


Stomping rounds

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/a3a1393cd80e729b365858e2b46f71c39677bf5f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/7e0f19f800e0d15781b632b2fc57b98d59d24371.jpg[/img][/url]

Stomping rounds will be a life saver when you come across a hoard unexpectedly. At the press of a button, you’ll load a cheeky custom magazine loaded with extra punch into your assault rifle where it will flatten a Screamer within just a few rounds. As you can see, the card is now in effect represented by the ammo count, and the card itself is now cooling down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/757cf0da094995d16542740944b9060dc5aea281.jpg[/img]


Soldiers helm

One size fits all, with this equipped you are slightly more resilient to damage from all sources. This one will be a favourite to many, I’m sure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/6b60941028abc007ecd93708aee94d8389b62626.jpg[/img]


Medkit

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c1f7f3dfd1317da03e0f7f6c4d09fafc2a3732c9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/5eb3382198ad17f1bc36ea400bf36a5ed687a6b8.jpg[/img][/url]

Another active card that will come in handy at the very last second. Can't find any health pickups when you're on your last leg? You no longer need to worry. Patch yourself up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/f3166ebf476f3b63b280fb57c1bb2bc46b8c2431.jpg[/img]
Now that was a close call.

Now, while a lot of the other equipment cards were taken out to be worked on, they'll be slowly introduced in bulks after release. So don't worry about content running dry, there's still much more to come.

[h1][u][b]Skill trees[/b][/u][/h1]

The tree of skills has been overhauled since we last saw it as well. All skills are split into their own categories and will give the user a better understanding of what they're choosing and how it will effect their gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/9c672bf180bcdf7557f4bf252f11e7b934d060cd.jpg[/img]

You'll gain skill points as you progress through the game buy simply slaying Screamers or bandits, completing missions and even finding little secrets. Future plans for this game post launch will involve new skills to be implemented as well. Right now we're seeing the skills players will use the most and what will be use less or ignored completely. Oh and I'm totally sure that you have noticed the skins we've applied to the characters as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/6849616d08b6991d3954f3e5960cb25bbb507f30.jpg[/img]

Just like the cards, other playable characters have been taken out to be further worked on and optimised after launch, for now let's enjoy our basic survivor characters and understand what makes them special. But not to worry, I'm sure some of yous are thinking this now:

[i]"We've seen other playable characters and cards before from previous updates. You're not cutting them and bringing them back as a purchasable pack?[/i]

Now let me quickly assure everyone who has thought this and the answer is HELL NO. I personally want to set an example in the gaming word where this modern culture of micro-transactions is ugly to a point where a lot of companies make it painfully obvious that their DLC is axed pieces of the original game with a price tag. Enjoying a game greatly make it so much better when you suddenly see a free content update downloading the next day. That's what I want to do for my game.

I just want to make sure that everything is done right. Either I can release the game now and continue working on parts that need fine tuning, or extend the game for another year. Let's face it, if you've been following me for a while, extending the date is not an option for me.

That's pretty much it for now everyone. Now that a date has been set, I am so excited that we're only just around the corner to releasing this project that TecShield and I have been working on for so long. Until then, have a good weekend :)

-Mr. Ox

notes.title: What's new 11/02/23
notes.content:
[h3][b]Fresh into the new year, here's what's been done...[/b][/h3]

So, from what I've told some people who have been asking questions about the game that includes:
[i]"How's the game going?"
"Is it nearly finished?"
"Wasn't it meant to be out by now?"[/i]

Well first off; the game is going well. Progress has been great and many new features has been implemented. Yes, the game and all the core mechanics are finished. It was pretty much good to go from its original launch date, that was the 2nd of this month! I kicked myself knowing that I had to delay it again, but I couldn't just release the game and have it as another generic shooter with a wasteland vibe. I want this game to stand out! So many people, reviewers, influencers and streamers from around the world have asked for a review key. I have obliged them all hoping that when the game does come out, it'll stand out, knowing that it is unique and worth playing. But there is a problem with balancing the games release vs features.

Now, I'm a very pedantic person when it comes to features for this game, however I see this as a scale that has two ends to it. On one end is the content that will come with this game at launch. On the other side is time, as the months go by, I am worried that interest will fade if the game takes too long to come out. It's kinda like a FOMO effect that I'm experiencing right now (Fear of missing out).

That's why I'm guaranteeing that TC:WA is going to be out before the [u][b]second half of this year.[/b][/u]
Now, let's get into the good stuff!



[h1][u][b]GUNS, ATTACHMENTS, PAINT-JOBS![/b][/u][/h1]

Nothing is more important to me than to make your weapon your own by customising it to look and play exactly how you want it to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/8a26df9a4bcd9fe9c0385c27cfffddbad9769279.png[/img]

We've changed how the weapons are presented to the player. Before, every gun simply started at level 1, whenever you could afford it, you pay to have the stats increase to level 2 and so on. That wasn't going to cut it, I wanted to further expand, make it more deep. Now, you pretty much have 1 of every weapon, you can own 1 pistol, 1 rifle, etc. Once you unlock it, that is now yours to keep. You can still upgrade the tiers all the way up to level 5, as you improve your weapon, you'll unlock new attachments and paint jobs. This makes the relationships you have with your own armoury more personal and more fun in the long run.

Nearly all the weapons have categorised areas that you can apply an attachment. They range from: muzzle, top rail, bottom rail, side rail, magazine size and bullet type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/540292647ec23eabf2358c78f0b9849745f98e4d.jpg[/img]

With a bit more tweaking to both the menu and the way the attachments are presented, I look forward to what combinations players will apply to their weapons and how they will use that to their advantage in the outside world in the harsh and violent city.

Speaking of which... the city!



[h1][u][b]SCREAMERS AND BANDITS![/b][/u][/h1]

More work has been going into the variety of Screamers that will mindlessly attack the player whilst they go about their business. By next week, we will have implemented different types of Screamers that you'll encounter. A crawler, one missing its arm or even their jaw! Some will be missing a part of their head while they try to tear you a new one. It'll keep the experience fresh and surprising.

You may also notice that their head has been scaled down a little bit. With the way they looked before, you would think that they'd topple over just by chasing you down the street.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/7f96abcc548b862608807b4a02f30bea553d6f8e.jpg[/img]

Not only that, you're also going to encounter other humans out there who are also defending what is theirs and fighting for their life! Pass them by if you must, but these violent individuals may want to take some of your stuff if you're carrying some high valued gear. Don't be surprised if you are randomly shot from the distance by another living soul. It is an unforgiving world after all...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/bdc20cef100308802a6bad1a35a8302e2a0ff527.jpg[/img]

I'm going to leave it at that for now. But don't worry, the game gets better and better every week that passes. Anticipation is building up every day for me, the sooner this game releases, the sooner I can pop open a bottle of some expensive sparkling. Until then, it's sitting patiently in the refrigerator.

Thank you all for reading and supporting this project. And while you're here, why not quickly check out my socials. Follow if you haven't already and even possibly check out the books that this game is based off of. It will definitely give you a better idea about what this game is about. :D
